fresh.title: Japan Education Ministry Discloses Government Procurement System Breach
fresh.summary: Hackers breached Japan's education ministry government procurement system, potentially exposing business records and email addresses. The ministry disclosed the incident earlier this week.

sources.title: Japan’s education ministry discloses breach of government procurement system

fresh.title: FIFA hacked, cybercriminals claim access to sensitive internal records
fresh.summary: Cybercriminals breached FIFA's internal systems, gaining access to limited personal and business data. FIFA confirmed the intrusion and is investigating with law enforcement.

sources.title: FIFA hacked, cybercriminals claim access to sensitive internal records

fresh.title: Microsoft Store App Found Delivering Vinci RAT Capable of Remote System Control
fresh.summary: Threat actors utilized a malicious Microsoft Store application and bogus installer to distribute Vinci RAT. The malware provides attackers with remote system control capabilities.

sources.title: Microsoft Store App Found Delivering Vinci RAT Capable of Remote System Control

fresh.title: Hackers Trojanize Official Q-Dir and DesktopOK Downloads to Deliver Remote Access Malware
fresh.summary: Attackers compromised official download and update mechanisms for Q-Dir and DesktopOK on the SoftwareOK website to distribute remote access malware. Security researchers disclosed the supply chain compromise affecting installer files.
fresh.action: Check downloaded installation files from SoftwareOK and verify integrity before running.

sources.title: Hackers Trojanize Official Q-Dir and DesktopOK Downloads to Deliver Remote Access Malware

fresh.title: Drupal site takeover vulnerability exploited in attacks
fresh.summary: The Drupal security team warns that a second critical flaw is actively being exploited in the wild to breach unpatched websites. Administrators should apply the latest security updates immediately.
fresh.action: Update Drupal to the latest security release.

sources.title: Drupal warns of new site takeover flaw exploited in attacks

fresh.title: Flight Centre Travel Group Discloses Customer Data Breach
fresh.summary: Flight Centre Travel Group reported unauthorized access to a third-party accommodation booking system. The incident exposed customer names, and in some cases, passport and health details.
fresh.action: Review booking system logs and monitor accounts for potential misuse.

sources.title: Flight Centre Travel Group warns of customer data breach involving some passport details

fresh.title: SAP Confirms Cyberattack Involving Stolen Employee Tokens on GitHub
fresh.summary: SAP identified unauthorized activity on GitHub where attackers utilized stolen employee tokens. The intruders reportedly accessed and modified source code repositories.
fresh.action: Revoke and rotate any compromised employee tokens and audit GitHub access logs.

sources.title: SAP Confirms Cyberattack, Source Code Reportedly Compromised
Software giant SAP confirms cyber incident amid reports of source code breach

fresh.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Attacks on Critical Infrastructure
fresh.summary: Attackers using AI agents breached computer systems at Swiss critical infrastructure operators in confirmed intrusions. The incidents resulted in no major operational disruptions and victims remain unnamed.

sources.title: Switzerland Confirms AI-Assisted Cyberattacks Breached Critical Infrastructure Operators

fresh.title: GoodGuys campaign uses fake expert interviews to steal Google logins
fresh.summary: An ongoing phishing campaign named GoodGuys impersonates major brands to distribute fake interview invitations that steal corporate credentials. Affected organizations should be on alert for fraudulent interview lures.
fresh.action: Warn employees to be vigilant against unsolicited expert interview invitations requesting credential logins.

sources.title: Fake paid expert interviews impersonate brands to steal Google logins

fresh.title: Remus Malware Steals Gmail Messages via Fake Google Sheets Extension
fresh.summary: The Remus infostealer deploys a malicious browser extension to extract Gmail messages from targeted users. The operators marketed this capability as a zero-day exploit against Google's email service.

sources.title: Remus malware steals Gmail messages via fake Google Sheets extension

fresh.title: PolinRider Campaign Poisons Over 7,600 GitHub Repositories with Malware
fresh.summary: Threat actors linked to North Korea poisoned more than 7,600 GitHub repositories to distribute a Python loader. The malicious loader conceals itself within utility packages or configuration files to initiate infections.
fresh.action: Audit repositories for unauthorized packages and rotate compromised credentials.

sources.title: North Korea-Linked PolinRider Poisons Over 7,600 GitHub Repositories to Spread Malware

fresh.title: Keenadu and Triada malware preinstalled on over 220,000 Android devices
fresh.summary: Kaspersky reported that preinstalled malware families Keenadu and Triada infected over 220,000 Android devices in the first ten months of 2026. The malicious software is embedded directly within device firmware prior to user purchase.

sources.title: Preinstalled Keenadu malware turns up on 220,000+ Android devices

fresh.title: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook
fresh.summary: A new version of the SYS01 infostealer delivered via Meta ads abuses browser management to install data-stealing extensions. The campaign targets user email accounts like Gmail and Outlook.

sources.title: SYS010 malware abuses browser management to spy on Gmail, Outlook

fresh.title: Beyond the Efficiency-Efficacy Dilemma: Adversarial Malware Detection Transferability
fresh.summary: Researchers introduced an automated security stress-testing platform called AAIE to evaluate machine learning malware detectors. They demonstrated that single-step FGSM transfer attacks achieved higher success rates against random forest models than iterative PGD attacks.

sources.title: Beyond the Efficiency-Efficacy Dilemma: A Critical Analysis of Transferability in Adversarial Malware Detection

fresh.title: BridgeHammer: DNN Backdoor Attack via CPU-iGPU Shared-memory Rowhammer
fresh.summary: Researchers demonstrated a hardware-based rowhammer attack that implants backdoors into deep neural network models running on heterogeneous SoCs. The technique induces targeted misclassifications by corrupting shared memory locations.

sources.title: BridgeHammer: DNN Backdoor Attack via CPU-iGPU Shared-memory Rowhammer

fresh.title: PRECEPT: Security Self-Improvement of Coding Agents via Evolving Principles
fresh.summary: Researchers evaluated AI coding agents and found they frequently reintroduce previously fixed vulnerability classes in new sessions despite fixing them when explicitly tested. The study highlights persistent security failure patterns in automated coding assistants.

sources.title: PRECEPT: Security Self-Improvement of Coding Agents via Evolving Principles

fresh.title: Know the Design, Pick the Attack: Sentence-Keyed Watermarks for LLMs
fresh.summary: This research paper demonstrates techniques to break or evade sentence-keyed watermarks implemented in language models. The findings show how attackers can reword text to erase watermarks or forge them onto unwatermarked text.

sources.title: Know the Design, Pick the Attack: Sentence-Keyed Watermarks for LLMs

fresh.title: Poisoning Attack Forces Denial-of-Service in Self-Evolving LLM Agent Defenses
fresh.summary: Researchers demonstrated an attack against self-evolving security frameworks where an initial prompt injection poisons dynamic defense policies. The induced policy over-refuses legitimate agent actions across evaluated models.

sources.title: Poisoning Self-Evolving Security Policies in LLM Agents

fresh.title: RegionAlign: Manipulating Parameter Layouts for Localized Fault Injection on LLMs
fresh.summary: Researchers introduce RegionAlign, a technique enabling malicious providers to manipulate model parameter layouts before deployment to concentrate vulnerable bits in specific memory regions. Experiments demonstrate how this facilitates targeted fault injection while preserving normal performance.

sources.title: RegionAlign: Manipulating Parameter Layouts for Localized Fault Injection on LLMs and VLMs

fresh.title: The Detour Is the Danger: Preserving Security During LLM Agent Recovery
fresh.summary: This research paper investigates workflow security downgrade, an attack where LLM agents execute sensitive operations without satisfying original security requirements during recovery from failures. The study highlights security flaws in autonomous agent replanning.

sources.title: The Detour Is the Danger: Preserving Security During LLM Agent Recovery

fresh.title: Volant Manticore Iranian Threat Group Targets Cypriot Organizations
fresh.summary: An undocumented Iranian threat group named Volant Manticore is targeting organizations in Cyprus for intelligence gathering. The campaign highlights ongoing regional espionage activities by state-sponsored actors.

sources.title: Cyprus Becomes Espionage Target for Iranian Hackers

fresh.title: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
fresh.summary: 1Password disclosed a data breach resulting from a compromised employee GitHub account used to deploy malicious code. Customer data was stolen during the incident.

sources.title: 1Password customer data stolen after employee GitHub account breach
1Password breach leaked customer names and emails, but not passwords
1Password Hacked, Customer Data and Source Code Stolen in GitHub Account Breach

fresh.title: FIFA discloses cyberattack resulting in access to personal and business data
fresh.summary: FIFA announced that unauthorized actors accessed a limited set of personal and business information during a recent cyberattack. The organization is currently working with law enforcement and relevant authorities to investigate the breach.

sources.title: FIFA says hackers accessed ‘limited set of personal and business information’
FIFA Says It Has Been Victim of a Cyberattack Accessing ‘Personal and Business Information’

fresh.title: CVE-2026-133275: Mitel MiCollab Arbitrary File Upload Vulnerability
fresh.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in its AWV component due to insufficient validation, allowing unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary files. CISA added the flaw to its KEV catalog after confirming active exploitation.
fresh.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions and CISA guidance.

sources.title: CVE-2026-133275: Mitel MiCollab — Mitel MiCollab Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
Hackers Exploit 10 Vulnerabilities Across Mitel, Juniper, Vates, and Danfoss Products

fresh.title: CVE-2026-133303: Mitel MiCollab AWV XML Injection Vulnerability
fresh.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains an XML injection vulnerability in its Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing component allowing unauthenticated command execution. CISA added the flaw to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following confirmed in-the-wild exploitation.
fresh.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions and CISA guidance.

sources.title: CVE-2026-133303: Mitel MiCollab — Mitel MiCollab XML Injection Vulnerability

fresh.title: CVE-2026-133311: Mitel MiCollab Weak Authentication Vulnerability
fresh.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains a weak authentication flaw in its AWV component that allows unauthenticated attackers to access sensitive information using predictable identifiers. CISA added the vulnerability to its KEV catalog after confirming exploitation.
fresh.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions and CISA guidance.

sources.title: CVE-2026-133311: Mitel MiCollab — Mitel MiCollab Weak Authentication Vulnerability

fresh.title: CVE-2026-133323: Mitel MiCollab OS Command Injection Vulnerability
fresh.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains an OS command injection vulnerability in its AWV component that enables unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands. CISA added the issue to its KEV catalog following confirmed active exploitation.
fresh.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions and CISA guidance.

sources.title: CVE-2026-133323: Mitel MiCollab — Mitel MiCollab OS Command Injection Vulnerability
Mitel MiCollab Zero-Days Exploited in Suspected AI-Assisted Attacks

fresh.title: CVE-2026-133324: Mitel MiCollab Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
fresh.summary: Mitel MiCollab contains a failure to secure authentication controls in its AWV component, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform unauthorized actions. CISA added the vulnerability to its KEV catalog due to confirmed exploitation.
fresh.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions and CISA guidance.

sources.title: CVE-2026-133324: Mitel MiCollab — Mitel MiCollab Not Failing Securely Vulnerability

fresh.title: CVE-2026-133469: Vates Xen Orchestra Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
fresh.summary: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an input validation flaw that allows unauthenticated attackers to bypass authentication and execute administrative actions using a crafted token. CISA added the vulnerability to its KEV catalog following confirmed active exploitation.
fresh.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions and CISA guidance.

sources.title: CVE-2026-133469: Vates Xen Orchestra — Vates Xen Orchestra Improper Validation of Specified Type of Input Vulnerability

fresh.title: Malicious NuGet packages used in fake recruitment campaign compromise .NET developers
fresh.summary: Researchers identified 13 malicious NuGet packages distributed through a fake recruitment campaign that install malware on developers' machines. The packages give attackers remote access, prompting developers to remove the packages and review their dependency supply chain.
fresh.action: Remove the malicious packages and audit all dependencies for compromise

sources.title: Attackers Target .NET Developers With Poisoned Job Assessments
13 Malicious NuGet Packages Turn Fake .NET Job Assessments Into Malware Delivery Traps

fresh.title: CVE-2026-103406: HPE Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
fresh.summary: A remote OS command injection vulnerability (CVE‑2026‑103406) was found in HPE Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root. Exploitation in the wild has been confirmed, and CISA advises applying vendor mitigations and updates.
fresh.action: Apply vendor‑provided mitigations and updates as instructed

sources.title: CVE-2026-103406: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router — Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router OS Command Injection Vulnerability
Critical Juniper Session Smart Conductor Flaw Exploited in Attacks

fresh.title: CVE-2026-120705 and CVE-2026-129243: GeoServer Flaws Exploited
fresh.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting two security flaws in GeoServer, including an arbitrary file read vulnerability. WatchTowr warned of unauthenticated remote code execution chains resulting from these issues.
fresh.action: Update GeoServer to the latest patched version immediately.

sources.title: Hackers Exploit Two GeoServer Flaws as Researchers Warn of Unauthenticated RCE Chains
Two Newly Disclosed GeoServer Vulnerabilities Under Attack
CVE-2026-120705: OSGeo GeoServer — OSGeo GeoServer XML Injection Vulnerability
